title: Sensitivity classification
description: The base does not fix the set of classification names — an instance declares its own classes in taxonomy.yaml (see ADAPTATION.md §4). What the base DOES fix is the shape: a name, and the key policy that name maps to. A payload carrying a classification whose key_policy is missing or is not one of the two allowed values is a malformed payload, not an instance choice.

name.description: Instance-defined class name, e.g. 'public' or 'client-confidential'. Opaque to the base.

key_policy.description: local-only reaches only locally served models. external reaches third-party provider APIs. There is no third value: the whole point of C2's enforcement is that a credential is scoped to exactly one of these two universes.
